caption: The drawing depicted on an oval platter features a detailed landscape scene centered around a harbor or coastal area, presented in grayscale. In the foreground, two figures are visible: one standing, dressed in dark clothing and top hat, pointing out towards the water, and another seated on the ground nearby. The landscape includes shrubs, rocks, and several trees with defined foliage, particularly a large coniferous tree on the left side. A body of water occupies the middle of the scene, with multiple sailing ships and smaller boats dispersed across its surface. On the far shore, there are numerous buildings and structures, including windmills and chimneys that suggest an industrial or settlement area. Additional figures, rendered smaller due to perspective, are seen walking along pathways and near houses to the right. The sky is filled with cumuliform clouds, creating a distinct backdrop. The rim of the platter is elaborately decorated with large, detailed floral patterns and scrolling foliage, which frame the landscape scene inside. The entire image is rendered in varying shades of black, gray, and white, with fine detailing in both the central scene and the border design.
title: Cup Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
